ns2:course.label: Community College Program Dev
ns2:course.description: Synthesizes selected sociological, psychological, and epistemological foundations for curriculum development in education and training; application of theories from fundamental disciplines to practice in existing and emerging curricula involving perceptual and psychomotor learning.
